checks.name: actual missing Keychain item is absent
actual Keychain add persists exact synthetic value
actual replacement updates existing item with complete Unicode
explicit injected write status preserves actual prior Keychain value
explicit unavailable-read status never substitutes or migrates legacy defaults
explicit injected delete failure retains actual credential and legacy source for retry
actual delete removes credential and its legacy rehydration source
idempotent scoped deletion preserves another actual credential
failed checked migration keeps its only legacy copy and no phantom Keychain value
successful migration commits actual Keychain data before removing legacy source
actual malformed UTF-8 yields typed decode failure without replacing it from stale defaults
checked nil assignment performs actual scoped removal
all dedicated synthetic credential and legacy fixtures are actually removed
one actual Keychain record round-trips complete account identity, both tokens and expiry
explicit injected account replacement failure preserves all actual prior credential bytes together
stored account is never rebound to a replacement client or scope
superseded generation rejects actual credential commit without changing the saved record
failed disconnect persists removal intent and blocks credential loading while actual stored bytes remain
actual disconnect retry removes the record and clears pending intent
failed atomic account migration preserves both original defaults/Keychain sources without creating a legacy copy
failed legacy cleanup returns no account while complete migrated credentials remain committed for retry
migration cleanup retry retains the identical account and removes every redundant old source
unknown or malformed present account cannot fall back to an old legacy account
disconnect also removes malformed account and legacy fallback source
failed actual-service erasure boundary persists blocked intent without claiming the explicitly injected failure erased credentials
actual service erasure retry clears credentials and both removal intents

scope: Actual signed-simulator Keychain values, atomic credential records, legacy sources and persistent intent flags; failure statuses explicitly injected at the checked boundary. No actual process relaunch, physical-device protected-data, full provider lifecycle or live-account proof.
